prompts.prompt:
Create a polished GAME DESIGN REVIEW SHEET, not a playable screenshot or cover. Attached atlas is ONLY the visual style and courier identity reference. Opaque warm ivory paper. Wide landscape with FIVE large clearly separated equal columns, thin brown dividers. Each column: LARGE recognizable courier-themed weapon prop upper half; smaller orange-helmet female courier using that exact weapon against a food monster below, with distinctive attack effect. Hand-painted 2D cartoon, warm brown contours, soft cel shading, orange/teal palette matching reference. Adult female courier with orange helmet, orange jacket, teal delivery bag, dark ponytail. No UI, logo, paragraphs. Label columns ONLY W01 W02 W03 W04 W05. Generous space, complete unclipped props, effects stay within own column. No military guns or generic magical staffs.
W01 DEFAULT TELESCOPIC FOOD TONGS: recognizable stainless food tongs with orange rubber grip, short telescoping handle, spring clamp jaws. Lower action: grounded courier short-stabs forward at bun goblin; short ivory crescent and crisp clamp impact star, precision melee, no projectile.
W02 PAPER TAKEOUT BAG AIR CANNON: folded kraft food bag in compact hand-squeeze frame, orange accordion bellows, teal strap and forward flaring bag mouth. Lower action: two-handed squeeze, THREE divergent cream air puffs with crumpled-paper flecks in broad cone toward food monsters. Air burst, not bullets.
W03 PACKING CHOPSTICK LAUNCHER: narrow bamboo chopstick dispenser, simple wooden spring rail, orange string ties, cardboard sleeve. Lower action: ONE bamboo chopstick flying straight through two bun monsters, thin amber stitch-like trail. No crossbow/firearm.
W04 THERMAL FLASK STEAM NOZZLE: teal stainless thermos, orange handle, short brass pouring nozzle, insulated shoulder sling. Lower action: two-handed sweeping milky curling steam plume in short fan arc, condensation drops, no flames.
W05 PARCEL SEALING TAPE GUN: orange packing tape dispenser with large visible amber tape roll, cardboard accents. Lower action: amber tape ribbon wraps ONE red takeout-box monster in crossing bands, taut narrow ribbon and small tear sparkle, bind then snap. No web or electricity.
Make all five distinct in silhouette/material/holding pose/attack geometry/effect while belonging to the SAME courier world. Design concept artwork, not runtime sprite atlas.

Create a polished GAME DESIGN REVIEW SHEET, not a playable screenshot or cover. Attached atlas is ONLY visual style and courier identity reference. Opaque warm ivory paper. Wide landscape with FIVE large clearly separated equal columns, thin brown dividers. Each column: LARGE recognizable courier-themed weapon prop upper half; smaller orange-helmet female courier using that exact weapon against food monsters below with distinctive attack effect. Hand-painted 2D cartoon warm dark-brown outlines/soft cel shading, orange/teal palette. Adult female orange helmet/jacket, teal bag, dark ponytail. No HUD, long paragraphs, title or logo. Label columns ONLY W06 W07 W08 W09 W10. Complete unclipped props, effects contained in own columns. No military guns, futuristic rifles or magical swords.
W06 DELIVERY TRAY BOOMERANG: round enamel serving tray cream rim/teal center/orange nonslip handles. Lower courier sidearm throws tray; bright curved cream OUTBOUND AND RETURN swoosh, few crumbs, no orbit shield.
W07 FOLDING DELIVERY UMBRELLA: orange-and-cream compact rain umbrella with teal handle, reflective delivery stripe, visible ribs. Lower courier braces opened umbrella in FRONT only against rushing takeout monster, canopy contact golden flash, small recoil, back exposed. No bubble shield.
W08 PARCEL HAND-TROLLEY RAM: compact teal two-wheel folding hand trolley, orange handle, single padded cardboard parcel strapped on base. Lower courier SHOVES AND RELEASES trolley forward in straight lane, paired dusty tire trails, pushing food monsters. Courier stays behind on foot, NOT riding.
W09 SPRING LUNCHBOX CATAPULT: compact teal insulated food delivery lunchbox, visible orange spring hinge, white enamel inner meal box. Lower courier flicks hinge to lob ONE sealed meal box in HIGH DOTTED ARC onto small cream ground marker, rice-grain impact burst. No grenades/fire explosion.
W10 PARCEL SCANNER ARC TOOL: chunky handheld barcode scanner teal rubber/orange trigger, square scanning face and red scan line. Lower courier points scanner; short red scan at first food monster then BLUE-WHITE zigzag electrical arc connects exactly THREE nearby food monsters sequentially. No continuous laser.
All five differ in silhouette/material/holding motion/attack geometry/effect within warm courier cartoon world. Design concepts, not final runtime sprites.

Create a CHARACTER ACTION DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for this SAME adult female delivery courier in the reference atlas. Opaque warm ivory paper background, 4 columns x 3 rows, exactly TWELVE separated cells. Hand-painted 2D game cartoon, bold warm brown outlines, orange helmet and jacket, teal crossbody delivery satchel, dark ponytail, white sneakers. Preserve face/outfit proportions consistently. Full body and feet visible in every cell, no clipping. Each cell has a small clean label A01 to A12 only. No monsters, text paragraphs, arrows, title or UI. Reference is visual identity only, do not copy its two poses for all cells. Show truly DIFFERENT bodily actions and weight transfer. Not a final sprite atlas, no claims of animation frames.
Row1:
A01 IDLE: full relaxed upright STANDING with BOTH feet firmly planted apart, knees soft, right hand holds short orange-grip metal food tongs DOWN beside thigh, left hand rests naturally near delivery bag; mouth calm smile. Absolutely no running/floating/fighting pose.
A02 SLOW WALK: one heel just contacts pavement, other foot toe pushing, upright torso, modest short stride, tongs held safely at side.
A03 START TO RUN: torso leans forward, back foot pushes, shoulders lead, bag trails with weight, tongs secured in hand.
A04 RUN STRIDE: clear extended forward leg and back leg, purposeful forward lean, ponytail trailing, visible foot contact.
Row2:
A05 RUN PASSING POSE: legs pass below body, one bent knee moving forward, support foot under pelvis; clearly different from A04.
A06 STOP AND SETTLE: front foot brakes gently, back foot gathers close, torso rises, bag swings slightly forward; not falling.
A07 TURN / LOOK BACK: three-quarter BACK VIEW, shoulder turn, planted pivot foot, ponytail and rear helmet visible, bag and clothing have correct back-view layering; do not simply flip the front view.
A08 MELEE TONG STRIKE: feet grounded, short controlled forward jab with food tongs closing, elbow extends, short white impact accent.
Row3:
A09 TRAY SIDEARM THROW: dynamic shoulder/arm outward release of round cream/teal serving tray, free hand balances, one knee lifted in a running step; emphasize attack while continuing movement.
A10 FRONT UMBRELLA GUARD: braced feet, orange/cream umbrella opens in front only, shoulders compress under impact, face readable behind side of canopy, short contact sparkle.
A11 WALKING STEAM ATTACK: takes clear walking step while upper body supports a teal thermos with orange handle and brass nozzle, short white steam puff forward; legs keep walking, no kneeling.
A12 NON-GRAPHIC DEFEAT: courier seated on ground after losing balance, helmet still on, one hand supports body, tongs dropped nearby, surprised rueful expression; no wounds, violence, tears or ragdoll.
Ensure A01 communicates unmistakable actual standing idle and lower-body gait variation across A02-A07, not twelve near-identical action poses.

Create a polished SKILL PICKUP CONCEPT BOARD for the same warm hand-painted night-market courier game as reference. Opaque ivory paper, wide landscape, 5 columns x 2 rows, exactly TEN equal cells. Fine brown separators. Each cell contains one LARGE real-world whimsical courier prop plus a SMALL effect vignette below it. Brown outlines, soft cel shading, orange/teal supporting palette, physical recognizable objects, NOT geometric placeholder icons. Small label S04 through S13 only, no paragraphs/title/HUD. Courier in vignettes stays adult female orange helmet/jacket, teal satchel, ponytail; enemy is bun or red takeout-box goblin. Complete unclipped objects. No guns.
Top row:
S04 insulated sample-food box: cream-and-teal food box opens with tiny dumpling samples and delicious amber aroma curls; tiny scene food monsters turn toward a box on ground AWAY from courier.
S05 bubble-wrap cushioning roll: recognizable transparent parcel bubble-wrap roll with orange securing band; tiny courier surrounded by a thin few-layer BUBBLE WRAP sleeve, one visible bubble pops at contact, one-hit protection, not opaque glowing sphere.
S06 three reflective traffic cones: three small orange rubber road cones with cream reflective strips nested as pickup; tiny scene shows three cones forming a SHORT LINE on one side of courier and a monster diverting around edge, not circular shield.
S07 arrival handbell: small brass bell with teal grip and courier number tag; tiny scene single outward broken golden sound ripple, nearest food monster has little dizzy marks.
S08 folding navigation paper map: folded cream map with teal route, orange destination pin; tiny scene luminous dashed SHORT ROUTE following actual paving with small courier moving along it, not full-screen compass.
Bottom row:
S09 telescopic pickup hook: folded brass-and-teal hook with compact cable spool and soft padded claw tip, physically different from metal tongs; tiny scene curved rope retrieves a green soda pickup toward courier, not pulling monsters.
S10 self-heating meal pouch: squat orange heating pouch with cream peel tab and teal insulated sleeve; tiny scene warm amber heat shimmer around COURIER'S HANDHELD TONGS only, short quicker-motion echoes, no flame shield.
S11 delivery dispatch terminal: chunky teal courier handheld terminal, orange rubber corners and tiny simple parcel route diagram; tiny scene one closed parcel-like GATE symbol at far arena edge with small clock indicator, existing food monster still active next to courier. Arrival delay effect, not time freeze everywhere.
S12 rush-order stamp: red-orange wooden/rubber office stamp and square paper order slip; tiny scene a stamped gold receipt mark near defeated bun crumbs and small amber spark coins-like POINTS but no actual currency.
S13 supply scan voucher: rectangular kraft parcel voucher with teal border and orange QR-like checker mark; tiny scene small supply box unfolds releasing THREE real props: tabletop fan, red skateboard and green soda bottle into three separate ground positions. No weapons in box.
All ten differ in silhouette and effect function; concept board for review, not production sprites or actual working gameplay.
